description: An analogue logic module: it takes two voltages and puts out their maximum, minimum, through-zero clip, mean and difference, each also inverted, and a gate and a trigger for each logic pair

params.text: Feeds the X side with a voltage while the pad is held, more of it nearer the middle of the pad; the maximum is the Pad max presssure slider on the context menu, 5V until changed
Feeds the Y side with a voltage while the pad is held, more of it nearer the middle of the pad; the maximum is the Pad max presssure slider on the context menu, 5V until changed

inputs.text: The X side of every function on the panel, and it takes over from the X pad as soon as a cable is patched
The Y side of every function on the panel, and it takes over from the Y pad as soon as a cable is patched

outputs.text: 10V while X and Y are further apart than the gate threshold and 0V otherwise, the gate that the through-zero clipper makes
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the XOR gate goes high
The through-zero clipper: X clipped to the size of Y, then turned upside down while Y is positive
10V while the larger of X and Y is above the gate threshold, and 0V otherwise
10V while the smaller of X and Y is above the gate threshold, and 0V otherwise
Whichever of X and Y is larger at each instant, which is the analogue OR
Whichever of X and Y is smaller at each instant, which is the analogue AND
The mean of X and Y, that is half their sum
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the OR gate goes high
Carries X itself, whether it came from the X input or the X pad
Carries Y itself, whether it came from the Y input or the Y pad
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the AND gate goes high
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the NOR gate goes high, which is each time the OR gate falls
Carries X with its sign turned round
Carries Y with its sign turned round
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the NAND gate goes high, which is each time the AND gate falls
Half the difference between X and Y, positive while X is the larger
Whichever of X and Y is larger, with its sign turned round
Whichever of X and Y is smaller, with its sign turned round
0V while the larger of X and Y is above the gate threshold, and 10V otherwise
0V while the smaller of X and Y is above the gate threshold, and 10V otherwise
The through-zero clipper with its sign turned round
0V while X and Y are further apart than the gate threshold, and 10V otherwise
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the XNOR gate goes high, which is each time the XOR gate falls

notes: with nothing patched to X or Y those sides read 0V, so the whole panel reads 0V until a cable arrives or a pad is pressed
the number of polyphonic channels comes from whichever of X and Y carries more, and every output carries that many; past one channel the panel lights turn blue instead of showing a voltage
menu: Oversampling — a submenu holding the oversampling rate and three switches saying which groups of outputs it is applied to
Oversampling rate: Off, x2, x4, x8 — runs the logic at this multiple of the sample rate and filters the result back down, which reduces aliasing at audio rates; inside Oversampling
Oversample logic outputs — applies the oversampling to the maximum, minimum and clipper outputs and the three inverted copies of them; inside Oversampling
Oversample logic gate outputs — applies the oversampling to the six gate outputs as well, and switching it on switches the logic outputs on too; inside Oversampling
Oversample logic trigger outputs — applies the oversampling to the six trigger outputs as well, and switching it on switches the gate and logic outputs on too; inside Oversampling
Clip at ±10V — holds the maximum, minimum and clipper outputs inside the rails, which the hardware does and the software need not
Gate/trigger threshold — a slider setting the voltage the gate outputs compare against, 0V to 2V and 1V until you move it
Pad max presssure — a slider setting the voltage a pad puts out when pressed dead centre, 0V to 10V and 5V until you move it

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the X pad.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the Y pad.
